name: Honeybadger
description: Monitor Honeybadger error monitoring for application health and incident response compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Honeybadger at https://app.honeybadger.io
2. Click your profile (top right) > "Authentication".
3. Copy your "Personal Auth Token" (NOT a project API key).
4. Paste it below — Comp will use it with HTTP Basic auth (token as username).

credentialFields.label: Personal Auth Token
credentialFields.helpText: Your Honeybadger Personal Auth Token (from Profile > Authentication). Used as the HTTP Basic auth username; Comp adds the empty password automatically.

checks.name: Monitoring & Alerting
checks.description: Verifies Honeybadger projects exist and are actively monitoring application errors.

checks.name: Incident Response
checks.description: Verifies Honeybadger faults (incidents) are being tracked per project and surfaces unresolved faults for triage.
